@@comment: The UI's messages in English, the catalogue's source (docs/I18N.md, phase 3; i18n/README.md for translators). After each message, @<id>: its context, its room (font, px, lines), its placeholders and what fills them at worst.
boot.touch_hint: Touch trouble? Hold a finger on the screen.

@boot.touch_hint.context: The boot screen's last line, under the logo and the version: the rescue when the touch is too far off to reach Output > Touch calibration. Holding a finger opens the calibration.
@boot.touch_hint.note: Drawn on the boot screen before the UI starts: the language is set before it.

@coach.header_tip.context: The first-boot tips' header: which of the 2 cards.

@coach.header_hint.context: Beside 'Tip 1 of 2': a tap anywhere on the card goes on.

@coach.next.context: The tips' header pill: the next card.
@coach.next.note: A pill as wide as its label, at the header's right: the hint beside 'Tip 1 of 2' needs what is left.

@coach.got_it.context: The tips' header pill on the last card: close the tips.

coach.title: The three red dots

@coach.title.context: Card 1's title: the Core2's three touch buttons are red dots under the screen.

coach.line: Under the screen: a click, or a hold, anywhere

@coach.line.context: Card 1's line under the title: each dot takes a click or a hold.

@coach.click_prev.context: Tip 1, the left box: what a click on the left red dot (button A) does: the previous track.

@coach.click_play.context: Tip 1, the middle box: a click on the middle dot (button B) plays or pauses.

@coach.click_next.context: Tip 1, the right box: a click on the right dot (button C): the next track.

@coach.hold_label.context: Card 1, each box: introduces what a hold on that dot does.

@coach.hold_prev.context: Tip 1, the left box, under 'hold:': holding A turns the volume down. Two lines at most.

@coach.hold_play.context: Tip 1, the middle box, under 'hold:': holding B switches between the speaker and the headphones. Two lines at most.

@coach.hold_next.context: Tip 1, the right box, under 'hold:': holding C turns the volume up. Two lines at most.

coach.tab:
Tap the tab you're on
again: back to its start

@coach.tab.context: Tip 2's big text, over two lines: tapping the tab you are already on takes that tab back to its start.

coach.tab_more:
The Library goes back to its lists, the Queue to
the playing track, Output leaves pairing.

@coach.tab_more.context: Tip 2, under it, over two lines: what 'back to its start' means on each tab (Library, Queue and Output are the tabs' names).

coach.tips_where: These tips are in Output > About.

@coach.tips_where.context: Card 2, last line: where to see the tips again (names the Output tab and its About row).
@coach.tips_where.note: 'Output > About' names the Output tab and its About row: use their words (tabs.output, output.about).

@tabs.playing.context: The tab bar's label under the active tab's icon (Playing). Only the active tab shows its label.

@tabs.library.context: The tab bar's label under the active tab's icon (Library). Only the active tab shows its label.

@tabs.queue.context: The tab bar's label under the active tab's icon (Queue). Only the active tab shows its label.

@tabs.dance.context: The tab bar's label under the active tab's icon (Dance). Only the active tab shows its label.

@tabs.output.context: The tab bar's label under the active tab's icon (Output). Only the active tab shows its label.

@toast.undo.context: The toast's Undo button (takes back the edit the toast reports).

@toast.view.context: The toast's View button after an add: shows the added tracks in the Queue.

@toast.nothing_to_undo.context: Toast when Undo found nothing to take back.

@toast.no_memory.context: Toast when a queue edit (play, add, remove, move) couldn't get the memory it needs; nothing changed.

toast.touch_first: Tap the screen first, then B plays

@toast.touch_first.context: Note when the B button was clicked after the screen woke from off and nothing touched the glass yet (the pocket rule). B = the middle red dot.

toast.no_headphones: No headphones paired: Output > Pair new headphones

@toast.no_headphones.context: Note when the headphones were asked for (a B hold, a play on Bluetooth) but none are paired: says where pairing is.
@toast.no_headphones.note: The toast splits at the first ': ' onto two lines when it is too long for one: keep ': ' there. 'Output > Pair new headphones' names the tab and its row (tabs.output, output.pair_new).

@toast.card_found.context: Toast after 'Try again' found a microSD card: the player restarts to use it.

toast.no_music_to_shuffle: No music on the card to shuffle

@toast.no_music_to_shuffle.context: Note when Shuffle all (empty states) finds no tracks.

@toast.shuffling.context: Toast after Shuffle all: the whole library queued in random order (with Undo).

0.means: the tracks (all the library's, up to 5,000)

@toast.now_playing_on.context: Toast when the headphones connected and the music moved to them.

0.means: the headphones' name (as they call themselves)

@toast.now_playing_on_headphones.context: Toast when the headphones connected and play, when they have no name.

@toast.skipped.context: Note when a track couldn't be played and was skipped: its title, then why (one of the toast.why_* texts).

1.means: why: one of the toast.why_* texts

@toast.skipped.note: Split at ': ' onto two lines when too long: the title over the why.

@toast.skipped_untitled.context: As toast.skipped, for a track with no title to show.

0.means: why: one of the toast.why_* texts

@toast.why_cant_play.context: Why a track was skipped, when nothing better is known (after 'Skipped <title>: '). Lower case: it follows 'Skipped <title>: '.

@toast.why_rate.context: Why a track was skipped: its sample rate is one the converter refuses.

@toast.why_cpu.context: Why a track was skipped: an 88.2/96 kHz file plays only at the 240 MHz CPU speed (a setting on the Output tab).

@toast.why_opus_not_ogg.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_ogg_vorbis.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_ogg_flac.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_speex.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_ogg_video.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

toast.why_opus_ogg_not_opus: an Ogg file, but not Opus

@toast.why_opus_ogg_not_opus.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_multiplexed.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_bad_header.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_mapping.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_surround.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_layout.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_no_audio.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open. Also a file that holds no audio at all (PlaybackController).

@toast.why_opus_bad_start.context: Why a track was skipped (after 'Skipped <title>: '): an Opus/Ogg file the reader refused at its open.

@toast.why_opus_family.context: Why a track was skipped: an Opus file with an unsupported channel mapping family.

toast.why_opus_frames: Opus with {0} ms frames isn't supported

@toast.why_opus_frames.context: Why a track was skipped: an Opus file with 2.5 or 5 ms frames.

0.means: the frame length in ms (2.5 or 5)

toast.why_opus_no_ram: no RAM for the Opus decoder

@toast.why_opus_no_ram.context: Why a track was skipped: no memory for the Opus decoder.

@toast.what_why.context: How a toast joins what happened and why ("Shuffling 5,000 of 19,412: the queue holds 5,000 tracks"): the toast splits at the first ': ' onto two lines.
@toast.what_why.note: Keep ': ' (a no-break space before it, as French writes, is fine): the toast looks for it.

@hud.bluetooth.context: The HUD over the tab bar after a B hold moved the output to the headphones: their name, or hud.connecting.

0.means: the headphones' name (as they call themselves)

@hud.bluetooth_connecting.context: The HUD after a B hold to the headphones, while they connect.

@hud.speaker_paused.context: The HUD after a B hold moved the output to the speaker: paused (the speaker never starts by itself); B (middle dot) plays.

hud.speaker: Speaker

@hud.speaker.context: The HUD after a B hold moved the output to the speaker (nothing was playing).

hud.silent_mode: Stays on the speaker (silent test mode)

@hud.silent_mode.context: The HUD when a B hold was refused in the silent test mode (a developer mode, entered from the serial console only).

@now_playing.title_none.context: Now Playing's title strip when nothing is current (dim).

@now_playing.unknown_artist.context: Now Playing's artist row when the track has no artist tag, album line or artist folder.

@now_playing.builtin_artist.context: Now Playing's artist row for a built-in test tone (queued only from the serial console).

@now_playing.cant_play.context: The progress line's middle (red) when the current track failed.

@now_playing.queue_empty.context: The progress line's middle when nothing is queued.

@now_playing.position.context: The progress line's middle while playing: the current entry's place in the queue ('4 of 16').

@now_playing.position_paused.context: The progress line's middle (amber) while paused: 'Paused, 4 of 16'.

@now_playing.position_stopped.context: The progress line's middle (amber) while stopped.

@now_playing.position_waiting.context: The progress line's middle (amber) while a play waits for the headphones.

@now_playing.output_speaker.context: The progress line's output name when the speaker plays. After the place and a dot: "4 of 16 · Speaker" (shown only when it fits).

@now_playing.output_headphones.context: The progress line's output name for headphones with no name. After the place and a dot, for headphones with no name: "4 of 16 · Headphones".

@now_playing.not_connected.context: The progress line (amber) when the output is the headphones but they aren't connected: never dropped for the sleep timer.

0.means: the headphones' name (as they call themselves)

@now_playing.not_connected.overflow: English: 'WH-1000XM4 (not connected)' is too wide with a 10-character name (cut with …).

@now_playing.headphones_not_connected.context: As now_playing.not_connected, for headphones with no name.

@now_playing.waiting_for.context: The title strip's second line (amber) while a play waits for the headphones to connect.

0.means: the headphones' name (as they call themselves)

@now_playing.waiting_for_headphones.context: As now_playing.waiting_for, for headphones with no name.

@now_playing.wait_try.context: The title strip's third line (dim) while waiting: which reconnect attempt.

@now_playing.wait_looking.context: The title strip's third line while waiting and the headphones are being searched for ('them' = the headphones).

@now_playing.wait_connecting.context: The title strip's third line while waiting and the link is coming up.

@now_playing.play_on_speaker.context: Button while a play waits for the headphones (and the play-failed dialog's left button): play on the built-in speaker instead.
@now_playing.play_on_speaker.note: Also the left button of the 'Couldn't reach' dialog (drawn in Small there when Body is too wide).

@now_playing.wait_cancel.context: Button while a play waits for the headphones: stop waiting.

@now_playing.seek_stay.context: The seek readout's small text when the finger is back where the track plays (instead of '+1:21').

@now_playing.seek_cancel.context: The seek readout (amber) when the finger slid off the bar: lifting now changes nothing.

@now_playing.go_to_artist.context: Navigation sheet (tap on the cover/title): row 1 opens the track's artist in the Library; the artist's name is the detail.

@now_playing.go_to_album.context: Navigation sheet row 2: opens the track's album.

@now_playing.go_to_folder.context: Navigation sheet row 3: opens the track's folder; the detail is the path cut from the left.

now_playing.builtin_not_in_library: A built-in track isn't in the Library

@now_playing.builtin_not_in_library.context: Toast instead of the navigation menu when a built-in test track plays (queued from the console only).

@now_playing.library_not_ready.context: Toast instead of the navigation menu while the Library index isn't loaded.

now_playing.synthetic_library: Browsing a synthetic library (uil0: the card's)

@now_playing.synthetic_library.context: Toast while the Library shows a synthetic test library (console command uil<n>).

@now_playing.shuffle.context: Playback sheet row 1: shuffle on/off (state as the detail).

@now_playing.sleep_timer.context: Playback sheet row 3 (opens the Sleep timer sheet); also the start of the sleep sheet's title and toasts ('Sleep timer: ...').

@now_playing.off.context: The Shuffle row's state (the playback menu): shuffle is off.

@now_playing.on.context: The Shuffle row's state (the playback menu): shuffle is on.

@now_playing.repeat_off.context: The Repeat row's state: no repeat.

@now_playing.repeat_all.context: The Repeat row's state: the whole queue repeats.

@now_playing.repeat_one.context: The Repeat row's state: the playing track repeats.

@sleep.title_left.context: The Sleep timer sheet's title while a timer counts down, and the toast after +10 min.

0.means: the time left: format.minutes or format.seconds

@sleep.title_end_track.context: The Sleep timer sheet's title, and the toast, when it pauses at the end of the playing track.

@sleep.title_end_album.context: As sleep.title_end_track: it pauses at the end of the album.

@sleep.title_end_queue.context: As sleep.title_end_track: it pauses at the end of the queue.

@sleep.title_fading.context: The Sleep timer sheet's title while the music fades out before the pause.

@sleep.title_off.context: The Sleep timer sheet's title when no timer is set.

@sleep.minutes_90.context: Sleep sheet pill: 90 minutes; says what the numbers are.
@sleep.minutes_90.note: The other pills are bare numbers (15, 30, 45, 60): this one says what they are.

@sleep.end_track.context: Sleep sheet, row 2 pill: pause at the end of this track.

@sleep.end_album.context: Sleep sheet pill: pause at the end of the album.

@sleep.end_queue.context: Sleep sheet pill: pause at the end of the queue.

@sleep.extend.context: Adds 10 minutes to the running timer: the sleep sheet's row 3 pill and the fade toast's button.
@sleep.extend.note: The tightest of its two pills: the fading toast's (the sheet's has 136 px).

@sleep.turn_off.context: Cancels the sleep timer (red): sheet row 3 and the fade toast.

sleep.hint: Fades out, pauses, then the screen goes off.

@sleep.hint.context: Sleep sheet, row 3 while no timer runs: what the timer does.

@sleep.fading_toast.context: The toast during the sleep timer's fade-out, beside its +10 min and Turn off buttons.

@sleep.row_end_track.context: The playback sheet's Sleep timer row detail (capitalised state). Same English as sleep.end_* (the pills).

@sleep.row_end_album.context: The playback sheet's Sleep timer row detail (capitalised state). Same English as sleep.end_* (the pills).

@sleep.row_end_queue.context: The playback sheet's Sleep timer row detail (capitalised state). Same English as sleep.end_* (the pills).

@sleep.row_fading.context: The playback sheet's Sleep timer row detail (capitalised state).

@sleep.row_off.context: The playback sheet's Sleep timer row detail (capitalised state).

@sleep.short_track.context: Now Playing's progress line after the moon icon: the sleep timer's state in one word (pauses at the end of the track).

@sleep.short_album.context: Now Playing's progress line after the moon icon: the sleep timer's state in one word (end of the album).

@sleep.short_queue.context: Now Playing's progress line after the moon icon: the sleep timer's state in one word (end of the queue).

@sleep.short_fading.context: Now Playing's progress line after the moon icon: the sleep timer's state in one word (fading out now).

@sleep.toast_minutes.context: Toast after a minutes pill was chosen.

volume.speaker: Speaker

@volume.speaker.context: The volume sheet's output name (the speaker's volume).

@volume.headphones.context: The volume sheet's output name for headphones with no name.

volume.label: volume

@volume.label.context: After the output's name on the volume sheet (dim): 'Speaker volume'.

volume.hint_headphones: The headphones' own buttons change it too

@volume.hint_headphones.context: The volume sheet's hint for the headphones' volume.

volume.hint_speaker: Hold A or C to change it on any screen

@volume.hint_speaker.context: The volume sheet's hint for the speaker: holding the left (A) or right (C) red dot changes the volume anywhere.

jump.title: Jump to

@jump.title.context: The jump grid's header (a tap on the A-Z rail): pick a letter.

@jump.second_title.context: The jump grid's second level: where it jumps in, the letter tapped, and how many rows start with it ("Artists, K: 12").

0.means: the list (library.segment_*) or a folder's name

@library.segment_artists.context: The Library's root header: the Artists segment (one of three); also the jump grid's title on that list.

@library.segment_albums.context: The Library's root header: the Albums segment (one of three); also the jump grid's title on that list.

@library.segment_folders.context: The Library's root header: the Folders segment (one of three); also the jump grid's title on that list.

@library.action_play.context: A Library row's action (inline bar under a tapped row, and the hold sheet's primary row): play it now.

@library.action_play_next.context: A Library row's action: play after the current track.

@library.action_queue.context: A Library row's action: add to the end of the queue ('+' = add). Also the Folders root's second button.

@library.play_all.context: The Folders root's first button: play every track on the card.
@library.play_all.overflow: English: 'Play all 19410' is 126 px in 123 when the Folders root shows the A-Z rail.
@library.play_all.note: The count is plural only where your language makes the words agree with it.

@library.hold_title.context: The hold sheet's title on an artist, album or folder: its name and how many tracks.

0.means: the artist's, album's or folder's name (cut to fit)

@library.header_artist.context: An Artist page's header title while the index isn't ready (else the artist's name).

@library.header_album.context: An Album page's header title while the index isn't ready.

@library.header_folder.context: A Folder page's header title while the index isn't ready.

@library.all_tracks.context: An artist's first row (and that page's header): every track of the artist, album by album.

@library.all_tracks_sub.context: The All tracks row's subtitle: '41 tracks, album by album'.

@library.crumb.context: The header's right pill two levels down (with a back chevron): back to the Library's root.
@library.crumb.note: A pill as wide as its label at the header's right: the page's title gets what is left.

@library.tracks_n.context: A count of tracks: an album's row and header ("2001 · 14 tracks"), the Output tab's Library row when 'Library: N tracks' doesn't fit, About's library.

@library.albums_n.context: A count of albums: an artist's row and header (library.artist_counts), About's library.

@library.artists_n.context: A count of artists: About's library (about.library_value).

@library.artist_counts.context: An artist's row and header: its albums and its tracks ("3 albums, 41 tracks").

@library.folders_n.context: A folder row's and the Folder header's counts: its folders ("3 folders, 12 audio files").

@library.audio_files_n.context: The Folder page's header: the folder's audio files (in a list with format.list_sep).

@library.files_n.context: A folder row's counts: its audio files (in a list with format.list_sep).

@library.other_n.context: A folder's counts: its files that aren't audio (in a list with format.list_sep).

@library.folder_empty.context: A folder row's subtitle / header counts for an empty folder.

@library.disc.context: A divider row before each disc's first track on a multi-disc album.

@library.no_artist_folder.context: The name of the artist entity for files right under /music (no artist folder): Library rows and headers, Now Playing's navigation sheet detail, toasts.

@library.loose_tracks.context: The name of the album entity for an artist folder's own tracks (not in an album folder): album rows, headers, Now Playing's album row, the navigation sheet.

@library.various_artists.context: The artist line of a compilation album (its records say compilation and elect no album artist; library.idx marks it, and it is drawn in the UI's language): album rows, the Album header, Now Playing's artist row, Queue rows.
@library.various_artists.note: An album artist tag that says 'Various Artists' itself is a name, and stays as tagged.

library.empty_no_music: No music found: put folders in /music

@library.empty_no_music.context: A Library list's line when the index isn't loaded (no music).

@library.empty_no_audio.context: A Folder list with nothing in it.

@library.empty_nothing.context: An empty list's line (the default for any list).

@library.looking_again.context: Toast after 'Try again' on the No music found screen: the card is walked again.

@library.synthetic.context: Toast when Play/add is tapped in a synthetic test library (console command uil<n>).

@library.waiting_for.context: Toast after Play when the headphones aren't connected: it plays once they are. Library: with Undo; Queue: an amber note.

0.means: the headphones' name (as they call themselves)

1.means: what plays: a track's title, or the artist's, album's or folder's name

@library.waiting_for_headphones.context: As library.waiting_for, for headphones with no name.

0.means: what plays: a track's title, or the artist's, album's or folder's name

@library.playing.context: Toast after Play: what plays now (with Undo).

0.means: a track's title, or the artist's, album's or folder's name

@library.everything.context: Stands for the whole card after 'Playing: ' (library.playing) and in a Play all's toasts: a name, not part of a sentence.

@library.plays_next.context: Toast after Play next on one track: its title (Library: Undo and View; Queue: Undo).
@library.plays_next.note: Also the Queue's toast after a row's Play next.

@library.plays_next_many.context: Toast after Play next on an artist/album/folder (2 or more tracks).

@library.added.context: Toast after + Queue on one track (Undo and View).

@library.added_many.context: Toast after + Queue on an artist/album/folder (2 or more tracks).

@library.status_checking.context: The Library's status line (bottom of its lists) during the validation walk of the card.

@library.status_reading.context: The Library's status line while the device reads tags: done / total ('Reading tags 1,234 / 19,410').

@library.status_updating.context: The Library's status line while the library index is rebuilt.

@library.status_unfinished.context: The Library's status line when a transfer's plan is still on the card (it was interrupted).

@library.found.context: Toast when the card's walk found new tracks.

@library.updated.context: Toast when the library rebuild finished.

@library.updates_at_boot.context: Toast when the rebuild was deferred to the next start (not enough memory now).

@library.updating_list.context: Every list's line while the library is rebuilt (the lists are fenced).

@library.updating_wait.context: Toast when a skip, seek or queue edit is tried while the library is rebuilt.

@card.another.context: Toast before the player restarts because another microSD card was put in.

@card.back.context: Toast before the restart when the same card came back during a card job.

queue_cap.full.one: No played track can make way: the queue holds {0} track
queue_cap.full.other: No played track can make way: the queue holds {0} tracks

@queue_cap.full.context: Note when Play next / + Queue was refused: the queue is full (5,000) and no already-played track can be pushed out.
@queue_cap.full.note: Split at ': ' onto two lines (what over why).

@queue_cap.why.context: The why line after a capped Play/Shuffle all/add: '<what>: the queue holds 5,000 tracks'. Lower case: it follows '<what>: ' (toast.what_why).

@queue_cap.shuffling.context: The what line of a capped toast (Shuffle all over the cap: a random 5,000 of the library), before ': the queue holds 5,000 tracks'.

@queue_cap.playing.context: The what line of a capped toast (Play on an artist/album/folder over the cap: its first 5,000), before ': the queue holds 5,000 tracks'.

@queue_cap.added.context: The what line of a capped toast (+ Queue cut short by the cap), before ': the queue holds 5,000 tracks'.

@queue_cap.next.context: The what line of a capped toast (Play next cut short by the cap), before ': the queue holds 5,000 tracks'.

@queue_cap.pushed.context: The second line of an add that pushed out already-played tracks.

@queue_cap.push_added.context: The what of an add that pushed played tracks out: the tracks added (one: just 'Added'), before ': ' and queue_cap.pushed.

@queue_cap.push_next.context: As queue_cap.push_added, for Play next (one: just 'Plays next').

queue.title: Queue

@queue.empty_sub.context: The Queue header's line when the queue is empty.

@queue.edit.context: The Queue header's pill: enter selection mode.
@queue.edit.note: A pill as wide as its label: the header's summary gets what is left.

@queue.selected.context: The Queue header's title in selection mode: how many entries are selected.

@queue.selected_of.context: Beside 'N selected': of how many entries.

@queue.all.context: Selection mode's header pill: select every entry.

@queue.none.context: Selection mode's header pill when all are selected: select none.

@queue.summary_position.context: The Queue header's line, mid form: where the queue is ('4 of 16'), then ' · 49 min' when known.

@queue.summary_nothing_next.context: The Queue header's line when the current entry is the last.

@queue.summary_up_next.context: The Queue header's line: entries after the current one ('12 up next').

0.means: the entries after the playing one

@queue.remove_n.context: Selection mode's bottom bar, red: remove the selected entries (the count must show).
@queue.remove_n.note: 104 px beside the trash icon, which makes way for a long count (132 px then).

@queue.remove.context: Selection mode's bottom bar with nothing selected (outlined).

@queue.play_next_bar.context: Selection mode's bottom bar: move the selected entries to play next.

@queue.clear_bar.context: Selection mode's bottom bar, red outline: opens the Clear sheet.

@queue.action_play_now.context: A Queue row's inline action: play this entry now.

@queue.action_play_next.context: A Queue row's inline action: move it to play next.

@queue.action_remove.context: A Queue row's inline action: remove this entry.

@queue.clear_up_next.context: Clear sheet row 1: remove every entry after the playing one.

@queue.clear_all.context: Clear sheet row 2 (red): remove everything; asks first.
